hook: Landscapers: *3 questions* before the first frost.
title: Landscapers: the off-season paperwork quiz

questions.q: You're adding snow removal this winter. Your insurance...
options: Is worth a call to your agent first
questions.why: Policies cover what they say. Ask before the first storm.

questions.q: Your truck registrations and crew licenses expire...
options: On dates you actually wrote down
questions.why: Same truck, different dates. Write them down.

questions.q: Your applicator license (if your state requires one) renews...
options: When the state reminds you, probably
When you check the date yourself
questions.why: Don't count on the reminder. Check the date and any training it needs.
